[http://web.archive.bibalex.org/web/20030110180610/www.ambicom.com/products/wave2net/wl1100b-usb.html Product page (via archive.org)]
[http://web.archive.bibalex.org/web/20040731104347/www.ambicom.com/products/wave2net/SpecsWL1100B-USB.pdf Datasheet (via archive.org)] The driver (available via archive.org) for this device references two USB IDs. They are as follows.. *03eb:7603 (default '''Atmel''' AT76C503A + HFA3861 ID) *0cde:0001 ('''Z-Com''' XI-750 ID) The device descriptor for both devices is '''Wireless LAN USB Adapter'''. A later version driver references only the '''0cde:0001''' ID with the device descriptor of.. *'''AmbiCom Wireless LAN USB Adapter''' This device is clearly a [[Z-Com XI-750]]. ==Images== [[File:AmbiCom WL1100B-USB.jpg]][[Has images::external| ]]
